prompt.traditional: 我妹妹＿＿游泳，她常常去海邊游泳。

prompt.simplified: 周末我常常＿＿朋友去海边。

answer.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ chángcháng gēn péngyǒu qù hǎibiān.
answer.english: On weekends I often go to the beach with friends.

questions.why: 跟 + person means with someone: 跟朋友去 means go with friends. 也 and 都 can't come before a person like this.

passage.traditional: 我的興趣是游泳和看電影。我每天早上都去游泳，游{1}很好。週末我{2}跟朋友去電影院。聽說這{3}新電影很有趣，我們星期六要去看，我{4}高興！
passage.simplified: 我的兴趣是游泳和看电影。我每天早上都去游泳，游{1}很好。周末我{2}跟朋友去电影院。听说这{3}新电影很有趣，我们星期六要去看，我{4}高兴！
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de xìngqù shì yóuyǒng hé kàn diànyǐng. Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu qù yóuyǒng, yóu de hěn hǎo. Zhōumò wǒ yǒushíhòu gēn péngyǒu qù diànyǐngyuàn. Tīngshuō zhè bù xīn diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, wǒmen xīngqíliù yào qù kàn, wǒ zhēn gāoxìng!
passage.english: My hobbies are swimming and watching movies. I go swimming every morning, and I swim very well. On weekends I sometimes go to the movie theater with friends. I hear this new movie is very interesting. We're going to see it on Saturday, and I'm really happy!

questions.why: Verb + 得 + description tells how well: 游得很好 means swims very well.
有時候 means sometimes: 週末我有時候跟朋友去 = on weekends I sometimes go with friends.
部 is the measure word for movies: 這部電影. 輛 is for bikes and cars.
真 + adjective means really: 我真高興 means I'm really happy.

passage.traditional: 今天是星期五，{1}是星期天。朋友覺得山上的風景{2}漂亮了，我和姐姐想去看。我{3}山上晚上有一點冷，姐姐說我們星期天早上{4}去，下午回家。
passage.simplified: 今天是星期五，{1}是星期天。朋友觉得山上的风景{2}漂亮了，我和姐姐想去看。我{3}山上晚上有一点冷，姐姐说我们星期天早上{4}去，下午回家。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqíwǔ, hòutiān shì xīngqítiān. Péngyǒu juéde shān shàng de fēngjǐng tài piàoliàng le, wǒ hé jiějie xiǎng qù kàn. Wǒ tīngshuō shān shàng wǎnshàng yǒu yìdiǎn lěng, jiějie shuō wǒmen xīngqítiān zǎoshàng yīnggāi qù, xiàwǔ huí jiā.
passage.english: Today is Friday, so the day after tomorrow is Sunday. A friend thinks the view on the mountain is so beautiful, so my older sister and I want to go and see it. I've heard it's a little cold on the mountain in the evening, so my sister says we should go on Sunday morning and come home in the afternoon.

questions.why: Two days after Friday is Sunday, so 後天是星期天. 前天 would be Wednesday.
太 goes with 了 at the end: 太漂亮了 means so beautiful. The friend loves the view, so the sisters want to see it.
我聽說 + a whole sentence means I've heard that: the writer has not been up the mountain yet, so this comes from other people. 應該 can't come right after 我 here, because no verb follows it.
應該 comes right before the verb 去: 星期天早上應該去 means we should go on Sunday morning, before the cold evening. 後天 and 前天 are time words and can't sit between 早上 and 去.

prompt.pinyin: Māma shuō jǐ diǎn chī wǎnfàn?
